title: Hardcoded absolute token-source paths tie the script to this machine
reasoning: The .env and config.json lookups hardcode /root/openclaw/ and /root/.openclaw/ paths. If the workspace moves, is cloned elsewhere, or the script runs in a container or CI, get_token() silently degrades to env-only resolution or returns None, making token discovery fail without an obvious cause.
recommendation: Resolve the .env and config paths relative to the script (e.g., Path(__file__).resolve().parent) or accept them via parameters/env, keeping the current absolute paths as fallbacks for compatibility.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests exercise token resolution outside this machine's fixed paths; behavior is only validated manually on this host.
suggestedRegressionTest: Refactor get_token(paths=None) to accept paths as parameters and add tests using tmp_path to verify resolution without /root/openclaw.
